_meta.purpose: Maps assessment context factors to persona-specific prompt variations, scenario filtering, and report tone. Used by the ReasonLens assessment engine to tailor the experience to each respondent's context.

persona_mappings.label: Secondary School Student
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios use school-based contexts. Language is accessible and direct. Avoid jargon. Reference school assignments, group projects, and peer interaction naturally.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Encouraging and forward-looking. Avoid language that feels like a school report. Use 'you' throughout. Connect each standard to real choices students make.

context_hints.discipline: Use to select subject-relevant scenario stems where available.
context_hints.prior_tech_experience: Use to calibrate assumed familiarity — avoid scenarios that presuppose tools a low-experience student would not have encountered.

persona_mappings.label: Post-16 / Sixth Form Student
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios can introduce more independent study and research contexts. Students are expected to make more autonomous choices. References to university preparation are appropriate.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Direct and peer-respectful. Acknowledge the student is approaching independent learning. Avoid being patronising.

context_hints.discipline: Can use subject-specific language appropriate to A-level or equivalent study.
context_hints.prior_tech_experience: Post-16 students generally have higher baseline tech experience — calibrate nuisance responses accordingly.

persona_mappings.label: Undergraduate Student
persona_mappings.scenario_tone: Scenarios use HE research, independent study, and group project contexts. Reference academic conventions, digital scholarship, and professional preparation.
persona_mappings.report_tone: Professional and peer-level. Acknowledge the student's capacity for self-directed learning. Report reads like a learning development resource, not a school assessment.

context_hints.discipline: Use discipline context to select domain-specific research and communication scenarios.
context_hints.prior_tech_experience: High baseline assumed. Attractive nuisance responses can be more sophisticated.
